subject.title: fix(msteams): avoid memory spikes from oversized certificate files

question: What maximum PEM bundle size should Microsoft Teams federated authentication support before failing closed?
rationale: Azure Identity documents the accepted PEM content but no maximum size, so choosing 64 KiB versus a broader bounded ceiling changes which existing operator certificate bundles remain valid.

options.title: Use a broader bounded ceiling
options.body: Adopt a compatibility-oriented limit such as 256 KiB while retaining bounded memory and explicit oversized-file rejection.

options.title: Approve 64 KiB
options.body: Keep the proposed ceiling after a Microsoft Teams owner confirms it covers supported private-key, certificate, and chain bundle shapes.

recommendation.title: Use a broader bounded ceiling
recommendation.body: Adopt a compatibility-oriented limit such as 256 KiB while retaining bounded memory and explicit oversized-file rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Microsoft Teams hardening work makes this the closest available technical routing candidate for the channel-specific compatibility choice.
